# Tests that fail under DEFRA_CLIENT=go-http because defradb.rs deliberately behaves differently from Go.
# Enforced by .github/scripts/testo-report.ts on the go-http job only:
# - each entry is `<binary> <test>`, with a `#` comment on the line above saying why it diverges; no issue is needed;
# - a listed test that passes fails the job ("converged: remove from the list"), so the list only shrinks;
# - a listed test that no go-http shard selects fails the summary ("missing");
# - an entry a pull request adds is printed as a warning naming that pull request.
# A test belongs here or in known-failures/go-http.txt, never both.

# Go accepts removing this indexed field; Rust refuses it. Go's indexed-field
# patch behavior is tracked at https://github.com/sourcenetwork/defradb/issues/4722.
testo index::remove_indexed_field::removing_an_indexed_field_names_the_index_and_keeps_the_collection_usable
# Rust names the missing path ("path /Foo/Fields does not exist"); Go reports "add operation does not apply: doc is missing path".
testo collection_version::updates::add::simple::collection_version_updates_add_simple_errors_adding_unsupported_collection_prop
# Rust names the missing path ("path /Foo does not exist"); Go reports "add operation does not apply: doc is missing path".
testo collection_version::updates::add::simple::collection_version_updates_add_simple_errors_adding_unsupported_collection_prop_at_root
# Defra.rs should return an error for a view source query with more than one top-level selection; Go silently keeps the first selection
# and creates the view (undesirable).
testo view::simple::with_multiple_sources::add_view_with_two_source_selections_fails_and_creates_no_view
# Rust stamps a migrated document only when every transition on its path ran a transform; Go stamps a partial read, so the
# field a later lens sets comes back null (sourcenetwork/defradb#4736).
testo issues::t_3044::indexed_collection_query_after_two_lenses_returns_migrated_fields
# With an index on the string, Go's `_like: "%"` drops every document; Rust returns the ones that have the field, as without the index.
testo index::like_nil::like_skips_a_document_without_the_field
# Go's JSON index never sees a top-level empty array, so `_all` misses it; Rust finds it, as without the index.
testo index::json_array_filter::all_keeps_an_empty_array
# Go's array index writes no entry for an empty array, so `_all` misses it; Rust finds it, as without the index.
testo index::all_empty_array::all_on_an_indexed_array_finds_an_empty_array
# Same gap, through a range under `_all`.
testo index::all_empty_array::all_with_a_range_on_an_indexed_array_finds_an_empty_array
# Same gap, through a range on a descending index.
testo index::all_empty_array::all_with_a_range_on_a_descending_indexed_array_finds_an_empty_array
# Same gap, on a composite index led by the array.
testo index::all_empty_array::all_on_an_indexed_composite_array_finds_an_empty_array
# With an index on the related field, Go returns ties in index order and ignores the second order condition; Rust applies it.
testo index::query_with_relation_tie_order::a_page_of_ties_follows_the_second_condition_with_an_index
testo index::query_with_relation_tie_order::ties_follow_the_second_condition_with_an_index
# With `_in` on an indexed field Go ignores `order` on that field and returns the rows as the filter lists them; Rust applies it.
testo index::composite_in_order::in_on_descending_first_field_ordered_ascending_follows_the_order
testo index::composite_in_order::in_on_descending_first_field_ordered_descending_follows_the_order
# Go's develop builds an index range from one bound of a two-sided filter, picked by map order, so it fetches past the other
# bound (6 to 8 fetches for 4 rows, 2 or 3 for an empty range); Rust fetches only the range. Go fixed it on shinzo-develop in
# sourcenetwork/defradb#5341, not yet on develop (#2527).
testo index::range_filter::a_closed_range_limits_index_fetches
testo index::range_filter::an_open_descending_range_limits_index_fetches
testo index::range_filter::an_empty_range_limits_index_fetches
# Rust re-runs an encrypted index change that loses a race, so concurrent changes on different fields all land; Go answers
# the loser with "transaction conflict. Please retry".
testo txn::new_encrypted_index_concurrent::a_concurrent_encrypted_index_delete_and_adds_all_land
testo txn::new_encrypted_index_concurrent::concurrent_encrypted_index_adds_all_land
# A query's read of a unique index entry (an equality filter, or a one-to-one relation's inverse side) decides nothing, so Rust
# does not check it at commit; Go does and answers "transaction conflict. Please retry" when another writer adds that entry.
testo mutation::add::field_kinds::one_to_one_to_one::with_txn::transactional_creation_and_linking_of_relational_documents_forward
testo txn::unique_filter_read::a_nil_writers_unique_filter_read_does_not_fail_the_commit
testo txn::unique_filter_read::a_unique_eq_filter_read_does_not_fail_the_commit
testo txn::unique_filter_read::a_unique_in_filter_read_does_not_fail_the_commit
# Rust refuses a second unnamed index on the same field (#3320); Go creates it as `User_name_ASC_2`.
testo index::new_duplicate::index_new_same_generated_index_twice_is_refused
# Rust refuses an index that repeats a listed one under another name (#3320); Go creates the copy.
testo index::new_duplicate::index_new_named_copy_of_existing_index_is_refused
# Rust refuses an index that repeats one declared by `@index` (#3320); Go creates it as `User_name_ASC_2`.
testo index::new_duplicate::index_new_copy_of_sdl_index_is_refused
# Rust refuses a second unique index on the same field (#3320); Go creates the copy.
testo index::new_duplicate::index_new_same_unique_index_twice_is_refused
# Rust refuses a vector index the collection already has, even with its HNSW defaults spelled out (#3320); Go creates the copy.
testo index::new_duplicate::index_new_same_vector_index_twice_is_refused
# Ordered by an indexed field of the publisher, which holds the relation, Go returns a null `_publisherID`; Rust returns the ID.
testo query::relation_order_with_filter::selected_relation_id::indexed
testo query::relation_order_with_filter::selected_relation_id_unfiltered::indexed
testo query::relation_order_with_filter::selected_relation_id_unfiltered_with_limit::indexed
testo query::relation_order_with_filter::selected_relation_id_with_limit::indexed
# An execute explain whose plan fails while it runs: Go reports the error as two `executionErrors` entries; Rust reports it once.
testo explain::simple::with_invalid_request::execute_explain_reports_a_run_time_failure_in_execution_errors
# Go's parity pin refuses a filtered truncate of a branchable collection.
testo collection::truncate::branchable_filter::filtered_truncate_of_a_branchable_collection_removes_only_the_matches
# Go's parity pin refuses a filtered truncate of a branchable collection.
testo collection::truncate::branchable_filter::filtered_truncate_of_a_branchable_collection_keeps_its_history
# Go's parity pin refuses a filtered truncate of a branchable collection.
testo collection::truncate::branchable_filter::a_document_truncated_from_a_branchable_collection_can_be_added_again
# Go's parity pin refuses a filtered truncate of a branchable collection.
testo collection::truncate::branchable_filter::a_peer_update_restores_a_document_truncated_from_a_branchable_collection
# Go's parity pin refuses a filtered truncate of a branchable collection.
testo collection::truncate::branchable_filter::a_fresh_peer_sync_restores_a_document_truncated_from_a_branchable_collection
